items.title: 7.4.1 Rate law aur rate constant (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.4.1, printed page 154.

blocks.text: Kisi khaas temperature par chemical reaction ki rate ek ya zyada reactants aur products ki concentration par depend kar sakti hai.

blocks.title: Rate law
blocks.text: Reaction ki rate ko reactants ki concentration ki shakal mein likhna rate law kehlata hai.
Rate law ek equation hai jo reaction ki rate ko reactants ki concentrations se jorti hai; har concentration par ek power (taqat) hoti hai jo tajurbe (experiment) ke data se milti hai.
Ek aam reaction lein jis mein A ke ‘a’ moles aur B ke ‘b’ moles react kar ke C ke ‘c’ moles aur D ke ‘d’ moles banate hain:
Is ki rate equation yeh likhi jati hai:

Yahan x aur y tajurbe se maloom ki gayi qeematein hain. Yeh balanced equation ke coefficients ‘a’ aur ‘b’ ke barabar ho bhi sakti hain aur nahi bhi. Isi expression ko rate equation kehte hain. Bracket [ ] molar concentration (mol dm⁻³) dikhate hain, aur proportionality constant (barabar nisbat wala constant) k ko reaction ka rate constant kehte hain.

blocks.text_alt: If [A] = 1 mol dm⁻³ and [B] = 1 mol dm⁻³

blocks.title: Rate constant
blocks.text: Kisi chemical reaction ka specific rate constant us waqt ki rate hai jab reactants ki concentrations ek (unity, yani 1 mol dm⁻³) hon.
Diye gaye halaat mein k constant rehta hai, lekin temperature badalne se badal jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Rate law ek formula hai: rate = k × concentrations (powers ke saath). Agar sab concentrations 1 hon to formula bas rate = k reh jata hai; is liye k ko 'specific rate' bhi kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Reaction A + B → C ke liye rate = k[A][B]² hai. Agar ek saath [A] aadhi aur [B] dugni kar di jaye to rate kitne guna badlegi?
blocks.explanation: A ki wajah se rate ½ se aur B ki wajah se 2² = 4 se zarb hogi, yani kul 2 guna: rate dugni ho jayegi. k khud nahi badalta kyun ke temperature wahi hai.

items: Rate law: Rate = k[A]ˣ[B]ʸ; x aur y tajurbe se milte hain, coefficients se nahi.
k = rate jab sab concentrations 1 mol dm⁻³ hon; temperature ke saath badalta hai.
